text: ロケットだんは　ポケモン　つかって　せかい　せいふく　したいのよ

structure.jp: ポケモン　つかって
せかい　せいふく　したいのよ
structure.en: wants to conquer the world, you know

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. せかい　せいふく　したい = 'want to conquer the world'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one; here the first is the way the second gets done. ポケモン　つかって = 'using Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end, here in the womanly form のよ, is a spoken form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining. したいのよ = 'they want to, you see'.
